newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB completes 3.68 bln peso property sale.
newsitem.headline: PNB completes 3.68 bln peso property sale.

text.p: The Philippine National Bank (PNB) had sealed the 3.68 billion peso sale of its 8,000 square metre property in Manila's Makati financial district, a bank official said on Thursday.
The bank, which auctioned off its property last July, signed the contract early this week, said Mario Nevado, an official involved in the land sale.
"It's already a done deal," he told Reuters.
The prime property was sold to RJ Ventures Realty and Development Corp. The company is partly owned by businessman Ramon Jacinto.
